note: Unified multi-region price registry. Replaces vice-city-prices.json and leonida-prices.json (archived). Covers all confirmed and predicted regions from data/gta-6/world/regions.json. Prices in GTA$. Populated from launch-day community benchmarks and GTA Wiki on Day 1 (Nov 19 2026).

monetary_dimensions.note: Each price entry specifies a dimension. Use only these canonical values.

dimensions.price: What you pay to acquire an item (purchase price)
dimensions.cost: Ongoing / operational spend (ammo per run, daily upkeep, fee)
dimensions.revenue: Gross income before costs (mission payout, sell price)
dimensions.payout: One-time discrete reward (heist cut, mission completion)
dimensions.yield: Recurring passive income rate (GTA$/hr from business)
